messages:
deploy-bot: [deploy-schedule] private-installer v1.9.0 -> staging scheduled for 2026-04-01 02:00 UTC (window 02:00-06:00). artifacts: installer-v1.9.0.tar.gz, shrinkwrap images pinned.
alice_ng: dropping release-notes draft in #docs after this thread. will include install/hotfix steps.
ben_p: building packages now. cosign signing will be done with ops-kms-1; I'll post signatures + checksums here when ready.
carla_ops: will ops team run the airgap manifest validation? need to ensure delta bundles present for on-prem customers.
dinesh_release: canary plan: rollout to 3 canary customers in VPC mode @02:15 UTC, 30m observation, then 50% capacity at 03:00 if healthy.
elaine_cs: looping in CS for the 3 canaries — they have permission to abort and will notify us in the thread if they see regressions.
ben_p: putting checksums now:
```
sha256(installer-v1.9.0.tar.gz)= 8f3b2a9d...c4e9
sha256(shrinkwrap-manifest-v1.9.0.json)= d2a7f1b0...9a11
```
cosign signature: cosign.sig: AE23... (uploaded to secure-artifacts)
ops-signer-bot: cosign verification OK for all artifacts. signer key id: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/releases/cryptoKeys/ops-kms-1
alice_ng: NOTE: release notes must call out quantization bugfix (Q-1274) and installer env var change: REDWOOD_HOME -> RW_HOME
ben_p: packing airgap delta bundle; reminder to pin runtime image to `redwood/inference:1.9.0-shrink` in manifests to avoid float.
carla_ops: verified manifest includes delta for onprem customers A/B/C. Also added fallback image `redwood/inference:1.8.9-stable` for immediate rollback.
dinesh_release: rollback plan: if canary fails, revert pins on gateway to `1.8.9-stable`, redeploy installer shim with `--force-pin=1.8.9` and notify customers. ETA for rollback <15m.
elaine_cs: please publish a short Customer Advisory template for canary watchers so CS can copy/paste on detection.
ben_p: one more step: uploading signed manifests to airgap bucket `s3://private-release/v1.9.0/` and tagging release in git: `release/v1.9.0-private`.
alice_ng: PR #4123 created for release notes and installer guide. @dinesh_release can you review canary section? link: https://gh/repo/pulls/4123
dinesh_release: reviewing now, left 2 comments about metrics thresholds (latency p95 < 350ms and error rate <0.5%).
carla_ops: pre-deploy smoke to run at T-15: `curl -sS https://staging-internal:8443/health | jq .status`
ben_p: also adding healthcheck container arg `--skip-metrics=false` so we can catch regressions early.
deploy-bot: [canary-check] at 02:25 UTC will run health probes and post results here. auto-abort if error_rate > 0.5% for 10m.
alice_ng: tagging release notes with migration steps and rollback commands. including example rollback command:
```
redwoodctl deploy set-image --component runtime --image redwood/inference:1.8.9-stable --force
```
elaine_cs: added CS template to the PR. ready to hit go once ops confirms final checksum match.
ben_p: checksum verification completed against staging download: OK (matches cosign verification).
carla_ops: final ops checklist: 1) signer ok 2) checksums ok 3) manifest pinned 4) canary runbook attached 5) change window announced to infra-oncall.
dinesh_release: infra-oncall notified. change window posted to calendar. final go/no-go ping at 01:50 UTC in this thread.
alice_ng: thanks all — will post release notes link and change log at 01:55 UTC. if no objections, we proceed with the scheduled window.
elaine_cs: :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: [schedule-confirmed] private-installer v1.9.0 -> staging queued (ts: 1767800000). will post updates during rollout.
